text:
Elaine: quick Lotus onprem update — staging hit intermittent 502s to model-gateway during smoke. looks like connection stalls on long-lived KV calls. anyone who owns the tenant egress rules around NAT/GW available?
Priya: hmm, can you paste the flow log + one tcpdump line? helps narrow whether it's client reset or our LB timing out.
Elaine: paste below (very small sample):
```
flow: src=10.12.5.43 dst=52.23.121.9 sport=40122 dport=443 state=ESTABLISHED flags=SYN-ACK,ACK len=60 dropped=1
tcpdump: 10.12.5.43.40122 > 52.23.121.9.443: Flags [P.], seq 132:276, ack 412, win 64240, length 144
```
Netty: quick read — two possibilities: MTU/PMTUD causing reassembly delays, or NAT device silently dropping long idle connections (no keepalive). do we set TCP keepalive on the gateway?
Ryan: I can own the ACL/egress CR for Lotus. assigning to myself to triage NAT policy. I'll open CR-4321 and add suggested changes. pinging netops for MTU check.
Priya: fwiw, ports we need open to hosted model endpoints: 443 outbound, 80 (health), 123 for NTP, and 853 for DNS-over-TLS if customer uses DoT. also make sure ephemeral ports 32768-61000 are allowed for client-side NAT.
Elaine: also customer is on an airgapped-ish VLAN with an egress proxy; they vendor-shipped a NAT box that has conntrack default 65536. we saw conntrack exhaustion in metrics around the same time.
Netty: okay add these to immediate mitigations: increase conntrack to 262144 and enable TCP keepalive (60s) on LB side. sysctl snippet:
```
# on the egress box / LB
sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144
sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time=60
sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_intvl=10
```
Netty: also if MTU is the issue, try lowering to 1400 on the path that traverses their appliance.
Ryan: opening CR-4321 now — adding: conntrack bump, keepalive, MTU fallback, ephemeral ports doc, and rollback plan. tagging @Netty and @Priya. CR link: https://redwood.internal/crs/4321
deploy-bot: canary deploy lotus-staging/model-gw v2.1.4 -> started by @Elaine :thumbsup:
Priya: one more thing — cert rotation. Lotus cert was signed by their offline CA last week but we haven't pushed the rotated cert to the LB. that can cause session resets when client reauths. Elaine, can you confirm certs?
Elaine: certificate rotated locally but not loaded into the bounce LB. i'll push cert after Ryan's CR lands and before canary progresses to 50%.
Ryan: CR submitted, added reviewers @Priya @Netty. ETA for review + merge ~2h. i'll also schedule a quick rollback window.
Elaine: action summary: Ryan -> CR + ACL changes; Netty -> validate MTU and conntrack tweak on vendor NAT; Priya -> cert rotation validation and ports doc; Elaine -> push cert and monitor smoke. i'll report back here with smoke result.
ops-bot: reminder — please add runbook step to CR for emergency rollback (5m) and who to page if smoke fails.
Elaine: smoke run now — running load profile + small prompt flood.
Elaine: smoke green ✅ no 502s over 5m, 99.9 p50/p95 tokens latency stable. will close loop once CR merged and prod dry-run scheduled.
Ryan: excellent, i'll keep CR moving. thanks team :heart:
